## Batch 88

Authored 15 A-page items and 2 B-page examples, including the closure and connected-sum lemma needed to justify the hump normalization. The A/B pages contain frontmatter only.

Final scoped checks passed: proof layout (17 items, 76 steps), precheck (15 proof-bearing items), strict proof contracts, rendering, source coverage (36 harvested results), source fetch (6/6 verified), and dependency levels (30-item closure, no mismatches).

## Escalations and blocker

The Conway existence proof remains unresolved: I read Garaev’s full paper but could not verify its R3 correspondence argument without a gap. The theorem and worked cases that depend on it are escalated. I also escalated universality because the plan’s “surjective over Q” could require rational-valued lifts; the current proof establishes complex-valued lifts, and the cited rational-associator result is external.

I attempted the native Step 1 recorder. It fails before reaching the assigned items with `Duplicate item cex-ip-continuous-time-frequency-aliasing` in another run manifest. **No Step 1 records were written.** I left that out-of-scope manifest and engine state untouched; the proposed item decisions and exact blockers are in the [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-88.notes.md>).

The recomputed autopilot status remains at `1-scaffold` with the global owner repair blocker. The [batch manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-88.pages.json>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-88.proof-contracts.json>), [source coverage](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-88.coverage.json>), and the new [closure lemma](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-kontsevich-long-knot-closure-and-connected-sum.md>) are ready for reconciliation. No acceptance or publication is claimed.
